title: Public outside rows adopt fully (Stop hook and .krn ignore) so the delivery records measure real gaps
body: evals/standards-audit.md: s-agent-state and s-finish-gate fail on every public row because rows hold only krn.json. The php row has no test, so krn adopt refuses; give it a real test or adopt with --no-canary. Owner of the row builder: scripts/outside-acceptance.ts.
